name: Vessyl
detailed_description:
Play as a masked cultist infiltrating the sacred temples of an opposing force to restore your deity’s full power. Armed with your fists and divine abilities, battle through intense encounters in this dark rogue-lite beat ‘em up.

Grow stronger between runs by offering devotion, earning boons and blessings from your god. Choose your upgrades wisely and become the vessel worthy of your quest!

What to Expect in Early Access:

  • Devotion System: Earn Devotion points by defeating enemies and completing runs, then spend them on permanent upgrades to enhance future play through.

  • Procedurally Generated Runs: Each run features 7 different room types, including combat encounters, challenge rooms, and reward chambers, all randomly placed for a unique experience.

  • Free-Flow Combat System: Use a mix of normal attacks, stun attacks, and unlock combos to adapt your fighting style and control the battlefield.

  • Enemy Variety: Battle against 3 unique enemy types, each with distinct attack patterns and behaviors that require different strategies to overcome.

  • Stat Progression: Increase your Health, Attack, Luck, and Focus by equipping trinkets or by spending points in the skill tree between runs.

  • Combo Unlock System: Gain access to new attack combinations as you progress, allowing for deeper combat customization.

short_description: Battle through shifting chambers in this dark rogue-lite beat ‘em up, mastering dodges, strikes, and fluid combos against relentless foes. Harvest devotion to unlock powerful new abilities, enhance your stats, and discover artifacts that transform your combat style as you fight to conquer the dark.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 1703 (Creators Update)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher
  • Processor: Hexa-core Intel or AMD, 3 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: N/A
